name: ArtCraft Store API
description: A public, read-only catalog API for PhotoCraft and EffectCraft plug-ins.

endpoints.pluginLookup: Fetch the catalog and select the plugin whose id matches the requested ID.

downloadResolution.note: downloadUrl may be an absolute URL. Otherwise releaseAsset or artifact is resolved relative to the store's downloads directory.

compatibility.unknownFields: Clients should ignore fields they do not understand.
